_notes_space_sites: Space sites (docs/space-jobs-contract.md; design page docs/mockups/space-jobs; game/sim/Space/SpaceSites.cs). Places in a star system between the bodies: wrecks, debris fields, a station (later asteroids, anomalies, comets, lifepods). Rolled once per system from its seed (a hash, never sim.Rng): generation.count sites plus one station, each at a distance from the star within generation.orbit (map units) and an angle from the hash, at least clear_of_body from every body and spacing from every other site (tries attempts each, then given up). weights: the kind of each rolled site. Knowledge per player: Detected (a long-range scan reaches it: a grey contact and its size), Identified (a SiteScanCommand within identify_range map units of it, taking the kind's scan_seconds × the sweep_time lever × 1.3 while the sensors are down; leaving range calls it off), Spent (worked out; it drifts out of the system spent_seconds later unless a ship is there or on its way). The station is Identified from the start and never spent. kinds: id (a SiteKind in snake case), name (on the card), letter (the contact's label: Derelict C-3), scan_seconds, size [min, max] (1 small .. 5 huge, shown while only Detected), variants (variant id: weight; known derelicts: earth / trader / native), origin (variant id: the card's words), hazardous (no work there below the hull's critical band), hazards (the card's list), alongside (seconds to come alongside × the alongside_time lever, then one debris roll: chance percent for hull [min, max]), away_table (the ship_status away_team table its boarding uses; none = no away team), research [min, max] (what a boarding's data core is worth there, by the site's hash), restore_power (seconds of Engineering work, or kits patch kits at once; a known derelict), logs (seconds once powered: latinum and research [min, max] by the hash), reactor (a known derelict's reactor: seconds after coming alongside until it fails, and the hull damage if the ship is still alongside then: the site is spent), sweep (a debris field: seconds of sweeping inside it; hull_every_seconds the hull loses hull percent; finds [min, max] things found spread over the sweep, always (found first, once each) and items (weights of the rest); a find that doesn't fit the hold waits until there is room: the sweep stops; the tractor must work; survivors from a lifepod by lifepod_survivors [min, max]). salvage: items the hold can carry: id, name, containers each, latinum a station pays, research a dropped one gives at a station or the colony's body. station: names, orbit (its distance from the star), dock_seconds (back to 100% hull and every system fixed), hire (crew a visit may hire: per_visit, latinum each; only up to the ship's starting crew), survivor_latinum (paid for each survivor dropped who doesn't join the crew). colony_reach_seconds: a colony ship's side jobs only offer sites within this flight of the colony's body. Phase 2 (asteroids, mining, selling, towing): generation.asteroids: count [min, max] asteroids rolled after the other sites (own hash salt, so the others stay as they were), near_belt percent of them at a belt's distance from the star ± belt_spread (when the system has a belt), the rest anywhere in generation.orbit; spacing = the least distance to another site for an asteroid (bodies: clear_of_body). Asteroid kind: mining (SiteWorkCommand "mine" at an identified asteroid; the tractor must work; one container of ore every seconds ÷ the mining lever (Engineering; the space cargo cutting_gear adds to it); ore per variant: containers [min, max] the asteroid holds (by its hash) and ores (resource id: weight, the ore of each container by its hash); rockfall: while mining, chance_per_min percent a minute (rolled each second) of hull [min, max] damage, and tractor percent of those knock the tractor out; mining stops when the hold has no room for the next container or the asteroid is mined out (then spent)). alongside is only offered where there is something to board (a variant with an away table) or power to restore; away_tables: variant id → the ship_status away table its boarding uses (overrides away_table). tow (on a kind): the kind can be towed (SiteWorkCommand "tow" at it, alongside, tractor working; "release" lets it go where it is); dropped at a station (ShipHoldCommand drop tow) it pays latinum [min, max], at a colony ship's colony body research and duranium (through storage), by the site's hash; then it is spent and leaves. tow.flight: × a towing ship's flights. ore: per_container units of ore in a container; kinds: the ores a hold can carry (resource ids), name, latinum a unit at a station; traders: neutral ships of these roles buy ore ("sell:<ship id>", or plain sell away from a station) when the flagship is in orbit of the same body, at share of the station price; a colony ship drops ore into its colony's stock (what storage takes), and a trade partner's body buys it at the station price. All numbers are placeholders. Phase 4 (chain-only kinds, placed only by a chain mission's place_space_site: never in generation weights or the event clock): hidden_ship (hidden: long-range scans don't detect it; one taken within fix_range of it from a spot at least spacing from the player's earlier fixes is a fix, fixes of them find it (Detected); until then the player sees a search area of radius area shrinking with each fix (its centre off the ship by the hash); once found, run_chance percent (by its hash) run run_distance over run_seconds, once, and can't be come alongside while running; "inspect" from alongside takes inspect_seconds × the alongside_time lever and pays reward latinum and research [min, max] by its hash) and alien_probe (probe: follows the flagship of the player whose mission placed it at speed map units a second until keep from it, holding while the ship holds at it; "decode" at it takes decode_seconds of Science work × the study_time lever, progress kept; "answer" then runs the ship_status away table reply_table with no one leaving the ship; an outcome in good is a good answer: that player's first contacts get shock points of culture-shock chance). A mission may also place lifepods whose survivors need hold room, a derelict with a cold reactor, and a rogue asteroid aimed at a named body (missions/notes.json).
